title: Legacy 2D Mob heads
description: 2D head items as in MCPE or 1.7 & below!
body:
How _often_ do you come across mob heads in Minecraft? I don't know, but I sure do remember what they **used to look like** and made them that! _(I mean, you see them a lot in servers' UIs—)_

_Better yet_, in three different **variations**, so everyone can pick!
# Dynamic _(modern solution)_
There's the '**Dynamic**' variant which simulates the appearance in GUIs while maintaining the **modern functionality**! _(of applying players' skins, other packs' textures)_:
![Dynamic ver. — Modern solution (Functioning)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a85d21f60e75b8620b5afd9d9a8810340b218b04.png)

# Fully flat
And obviously there're the variants that **bring back** the old look **fully**, comparison of which you can see up ahead:
![Frames: Default, Legacy, Renewed legacy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cca98c7d4bbf7304fbe45358e480ce8b1a65c41c.png)

*_**If** you do use this in a pack of your own, please mention me_
